decisions.kitchen: Existing fittings adjusted: HD-14 moved KIT-H2 to the window wall and KIT-H7 (DL7 -> DL10); OPT-1 moves KIT-H1 1.7 ft toward the sink end. Work-scene U0 by case: HD-11 positions 0.542; HD-14 positions (before OPT-1) 0.581; OPT-1 moves only (KIT-H1), before the sink-end balance 0.603; current: OPT-1 moves + sink-end balance (KIT-T4 added; KIT-T1 lower output) 0.651; HD-14 sink-end linear test (x 2.9 ft, HIGH lane; not adopted) 0.598. Moves alone and a lower-output left-run strip alone stay below U0 0.60, so OPT-1 adds the sink-end task linear KIT-T4 (TASK lane, C16 knob) and lowers KIT-T1 to a same-family lower-output strip; the HIGH+TASK worktop now meets 500 lx / U0 0.60 with a thin margin. Residual risk: assumed cabinet/window geometry, generic optics, reflectance 0.30 drops it below target, strip colour/bin match and product-fit clearance; confirm on measured geometry before task-light sign-off.
decisions.children: CPL-1 computed on the planned R05 frame (not surveyed): B6 HIGH grid (6 fittings, none under the loft), TASK_HO desk strip, swivel readers, wardrobe face and TV ambient; bed cases queen / king-centred / king-anchored. OPT-1 moved CBR-H5 to uv (3.88, 2.59) m so it leaves the supine view cone of all six bed cases; CBR-H6 remains (alternatives fail HIGH uniformity or the loft keep-clear). Re-run on surveyed geometry.
decisions.master: CPL-1 computed at the HELD test centreline (OI-BED-01/OI-MBR-04): queen fits (0.124 m each side), king does not (-0.029 m). HD-14: fixed bedside cabinets omitted (movable tenant tables); no outboard wall space, so plates SB-05L/R move up to 1.30 m above an ASSUMED <=1.20 m headboard (MARGINAL until the headboard is known). Bed-exit night path below 1 lx: HOLD (optional second step light). HIGH group C20 (8 fittings, 48 W) stays on one dimmer subject to the procurement condition in controls.dimmer_listing_screen; split only if the documented lamp input or listing requires it (decide at OI-MBR-04).
decisions.pooja: Current provisional niche geometry conflicts with the modeled wall and inherited fittings (H-POOJA-GEOMETRY). No idol-lux or dim-setting recommendation carried forward. LIV-P1/P2 stay in count/load allowances, not an order. Measure the already-built cavity, exterior section and idol plane before revising fitting positions/lengths
decisions.zones: Bath zones equal the master bath rectangles. Other lighting zones keep the scaled approximate trace with a stated purpose and are RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED against labelled sizes; nothing is stretched to agree.
decisions.night: Use provisional MBR 55 % and LOB 40 % output. MBR prioritises the minimum but remains MARGINAL; no acceptance of the above-target average is implied.
decisions.art: Retain track and scene-specific dim settings. OPT-1 lowers the three head aims to [1.45] m: U0 0.55 at track 100 % passes the 0.5 target with generic optics and an ASSUMED artwork size/position; confirm by aiming on site with the selected heads.
decisions.curtains: HD-14: LIV/MBR/CBR carry two ceiling tracks (sheer + blackout) in the recessed pockets; pocket width/depth unverified and not enlarged (H-CURTAIN-POCKET). OPT-1 moves LIV-H1..H4 and DIN-H1 0.35 ft further from the window wall so the modeled cut-out clearance is no longer tight; still confirm cut-outs and the MBR-L2 headboard back-light start against the measured pocket/stack.
decisions.groups: OPT-1 regroups the two existing living-room dimmers by plan halves without adding a dimmer: C01 = window line LIV-H1..H4 + LIV-H5 (40 W / 5 lamps), C02 = LIV-H6/H7 + TV-wall gimbals LIV-H8..H10 (40 W / 5 lamps); master C01 (56 W / 7 lamps) was above the screened 50 W listing. C20 (MBR, 48 W / 8 lamps) is inside the listing and stays single, conditional on documented lamp input <= 6.25 W (fallback: split, higher-rated dimmer or fewer fittings, decided at OI-MBR-04). The 40 W / 7-lamp planning margin is a project assumption, not a reason on its own to add dimmers. One listed product (Legrand Lyncus 677304, 3-50 W LED, max 8 lamps) is a screen only; the exact fitting/driver/dimmer chain remains unproven.
decisions.bath_supply_R1: Independent bathroom spot supplies (electrical-session resilience proposal) are shown as a costed alternative in the optimization evidence, NOT adopted: TL1/TL2 keep one 200 W / 240 W supply each.
decisions.bath_face: HD-14 base: two diffused vertical face lights beside each mirror (TL1-F1/F2, TL2-F1/F2) on their own knob (C29B/C35B) plus the close-spaced ceiling vanity pair (C29A/C35A). Grooming = face 100 % + pair at the calculated level. Included once in loads, PSUs and BoM.
decisions.bath_site: Door hinge on the vanity-side jamb is a design interpretation pending a site check; place the bath knob outside on the latch (max-z) side. IP rating is not wet-zone permission: the electrician defines zones, RCD/SELV and approvals.
decisions.procurement: Require matched drivers/dimmers, documented thermal derating, and electrician zone/protection approval before procurement or installation; the example architecture is not a selected product chain.
